title: Choose Brittle's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Bench Instrument. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bench Instrument
options.lineage: precision lab meters and channel-strip consoles
options.thesis: Brittle as one calibrated measuring instrument: a scale, a readout, a row of channel faders.
options.viewport: A wide calibrated 0–100 scale across the top with the score as a damped indicator and the SPOF readout beside it; holdings below as channel faders, figures beneath.
options.risk: Can read as a hardware skeuomorph if the faceplate gets textures or bevels; it must stay flat and typographic.

raised.raise: The scale is one calibrated rail: every holding sits on it as a hairline at its factor exposure, the SPOF line doubled, state carried by line form not hue.
Every number sits in a fixed ruled field so values change in place with zero layout shift.
Nothing is labelled twice; one figure owns the first viewport and the rest is quiet black.
Hovering or focusing a holding dims every other holding across all figures at once.

options.label: Research Tear Sheet
options.lineage: quant research tear sheets (pyfolio, risk reports)
options.thesis: The portfolio printed as a live research report: numbered figures, a stats table, one reading column.
options.viewport: Report header with score and SPOF as Fig. 1, holdings as an editable table, figures flowing below.
options.risk: Familiar: close to where most quant-tool runs land; risks feeling like a static document rather than a toy.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.thesis: Every quantity is a needle-thin line on one off-centre calibrated rail.
options.viewport: One rail; holdings as lines at their exposure, the SPOF doubled and brightest.
options.case: Holds product clarity (exposure as position is honest) but loses audience identification: spectroscopy isn't the recruiter's world.
options.risk: Too austere for a first-minute visitor; numbers become hard to read.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each holding a carbon coupon in a wallet.
options.case: Loses both axes: travel ephemera says nothing about correlated risk.
options.kept: Fixed ruled fields for every number.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: A pulsar plot on matte black.
options.case: Loses both: coded labels fight 'easy to use'.
options.kept: One figure owns the viewport; nothing labelled twice.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.case: Loses both: no artwork exists and tiles hide the math.
options.kept: Focus on one item dims everything else.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark fintech dashboard: card grid, big gauge, charts, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Header, controls column left, card grid of results right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every portfolio dashboard by design.
